'''María del Coral Barbas Arribas''' (or '''Arriba''') is a professor at the [[Universidad CEU San Pablo]] in Madrid, Spain who is known for her research on [[metabolomics]] and the integration of chemical data.{{clarify|issue=what is "integration of chemical data"?|date=April 2022}}

== Education and career ==
Barbas has a Ph.D. from [[Complutense University of Madrid]].<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Preparacion, puesta a punto y aplicaciones analiticas de electrodos selectivos de membrana heterogenea de Ag(I) y de Cu(II)|url=https://www.worldcat.org/title/preparacion-puesta-a-punto-y-aplicaciones-analiticas-de-electrodos-selectivos-de-membrana-heterogenea-de-agi-y-de-cuii/oclc/802737179|publisher=Universidad Complutense de Madrid. Servicio de Reprografia|date=1989|place=Madrid|language=Spanish|first=Maria del Coral|last=Barbas Arriba}}</ref> From 2005 until 2006 she was a [[Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions|Marie Curie fellow]] at [[King's College London]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|date=December 17, 2018|title=Coral Barbas, catedrática de Química Analítica de la Universidad CEU San Pablo, Doctora Honoris Causa por la Medical University Bialystok (Polonia) – elEconomista.es|url=https://www.eleconomista.es/ecoaula/noticias/9587276/12/18/Coral-Barbas-catedratica-de-Quimica-Analitica-de-la-Universidad-CEU-San-Pablo-Doctora-Honoris-Causa-por-la-Medical-University-Bialystok-Polonia.html|access-date=2022-02-17|website=www.eleconomista.es|language=es}}</ref> As of 2022 she is a professor of [[analytical chemistry]] at the [[Universidad CEU San Pablo]] and is the president of the Madrid section of the [[Spanish Royal Society of Chemistry]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|title=CEMBIO CEU. Centre of Metabolomics and Bioanalysis|url=https://cembio.uspceu.es/members/|access-date=2022-02-17|website=cembio.uspceu.es|language=en}}</ref>

== Research ==
Barbas is known for her research on metabolomics, a field she was first introduced to while she was a Marie Curie fellow.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Coral Barbas|url=https://theanalyticalscientist.com/power-list/the-power-list-2016/coral-barbas|access-date=2022-02-17|website=The Analytical Scientist|language=en}}</ref> Her early research centered on the analysis of vitamins<ref>{{Cite vitamins A and E in rat tissues by high-performance liquid chromatography|journal=Journal of Chromatography analyze compounds such as caffeine.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbas|first1=Coral|last2=Garcı́a|first2=Antonia|last3=Saavedra|first3=Luis|last4=Castro|first4=Mario|date=2000-02-18|title=Optimization == Awards and honors ==
''[[The Analytical Scientist]]'' named Barbas to their 2016 Power List in recognition of her contributions to chemistry.<ref name=":1" /> In 2017, she was honored by ''[[Acta Sanitaria]]'' for her chemical research linking diabetes and obesity.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-05-12|title=Coral Barbas, galardonada con el premio Endocrinología Pediátrica y Crecimiento 2017|url=https://www.actasanitaria.com/nombres/coral-barbas-galardonada-con-el-premio-endocrinologia-pediatrica-y-crecimiento-2017_1290399_102.html|access-date=2022-02-17|website=Acta Sanitaria|language=es|archive-date=2022-02-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220217130106/https://www.actasanitaria.com/nombres/coral-barbas-galardonada-con-el-premio-endocrinologia-pediatrica-y-crecimiento-2017_1290399_102.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2018, she received the International Award of the [[Belgian Society of Pharmaceutical Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=International Award|url=http://www.bsps.be/int-award/|access-date=2022-02-17|website=Belgian Society of Pharmaceutical Sciences|language=en-US}}</ref>
